title: Private Afternoon Snorkel with Sunset Sail in Key West
includes: Ice, soft drinks, and bottled water
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
policies: Pricing is based per charter, for a maximum of six passengers
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Please Note: Price of $695 is for up to 6 guests. Enjoy this private charter with friends or that special someone! Soak up the afternoon sun and cool off in the bright aqua waters of the Keys as you snorkel and explore Florida's amazing natural wildlife with up to five others, before sailing back to shore at sunset.
